# Sterova

Sterova is a custom software development company based in Chennai, India. We build high-performance web applications, mobile apps, and scalable digital products for modern enterprises and ambitious startups.

## Services
- Custom Software Development (Web, Mobile, Cloud)
- Web App Development (React, Node.js, Supabase, Postgres)
- Mobile App Development (React Native, iOS, Android)
- UI/UX Design
